name: Katipunan Study Room A
description: Bright, quiet study room with spacious desks and fast, reliable Wi-Fi—just minutes from Ateneo and UP Diliman along Katipunan. Air-conditioned with plenty of charging ports and good lighting, perfect for solo work or group review. Cafés and LRT-2 Katipunan are a short walk away.

name: WorkHaven Makati
description: CA professional co-working environment in the heart of the business district. Ideal for meetings, collaborations, and networking.

name: The Study Nook
description: A quiet and cozy space perfect for deep focus sessions. Equipped with soundproof pods and an extensive library for a productive day.

name: Cebu Creative Hub
description: A vibrant and artistic space designed to foster creativity and collaboration among Cebu's digital nomads and artists.

name: Uptown Co-Work
description: Modern co-working space on 30th Street in BGC with sunlit open desks and bookable meeting rooms by the hour. Fast enterprise Wi-Fi, plenty of outlets, ergonomic seating, and air-conditioning; printer, pantry, and phone booths on site. Steps from Bonifacio High Street and Uptown, with 24/7 security and paid parking available.

name: Baguio Loft
description: Cozy loft in Baguio’s cool mountain air, a short walk from Burnham Park—perfect for long, focused study blocks. Fast Wi-Fi, spacious desks, ample outlets, and warm lighting; heater and blackout curtains keep things comfy and quiet. Cafés and jeepney/taxi stops are nearby along Session Road.

name: Riverside Pods
description: Private, noise-controlled study pods just off J.P. Laurel Avenue in Davao. Each pod is acoustically treated and ventilated, with fast Wi-Fi, charging ports, adjustable task lighting, and a comfy desk-and-chair setup—ideal for online classes, exams, or video calls. Walkable from Abreeza and nearby cafés; easy jeepney/taxi access.

name: Iloilo Study Café
description: Cafe-style study spot near Iloilo Business Park with strong Wi-Fi and plenty of outlets at every table. Air-conditioned, barista coffee on site, and mixed seating (booths, long tables, window bars) suited for solo focus or small groups. Walkable to Megaworld shops and jeepney/taxi stops; quiet hours observed during peak study times.

name: Pasig Focus Hub
description: Minimalist deep-work hub just steps from Ortigas MRT along EDSA. Clean, uncluttered desks with fast enterprise Wi-Fi, abundant outlets, and air-conditioning, plus focus booths/phone pods for calls. Quiet policy, ergonomic seating, pantry and printer on site; walkable to SM Megamall and Robinsons Galleria with easy bus/jeepney access.

name: Bacolod Think Tank
description: Budget-friendly open space along Lacson with nearby eateries. Wallet-friendly study hall on Lacson Street, Bacolod—steps from popular eateries. Fast Wi-Fi,air-conditioning, and ample outlets; shared long tables for group work and quiet corners for solo focus. Easy jeepney/taxi access along the Lacson corridor

name: CDO Study Commons
description: Group tables with whiteboards near Gaston Park. Collaborative study commons in Cagayan de Oro near Gaston Park, with large group tables and wall whiteboards. Reliable Wi-Fi, free water station, and air-conditioning; perfect for review sessions and workshops. Walkable from Divisoria and nearby cafes

name: Laguna Study Hall
description: Quiet hall near UPLB with mountain views.Peaceful study hall in Los Baños near UPLB, with window seats facing Mt. Makiling. Strong Wi-Fi, cool air-conditioning, and plenty of charging ports; ideal for long reading blocks. Trikes and jeepneys pass regularly along Lopez Ave.

name: Pampanga Readery
description: Warm lighting and comfy chairs near Nepo Quad. Cozy readery in Angeles (Pampanga) by Nepo Quad, featuring warm ambient lighting and cushioned seating. Fast Wi-Fi, snacks and water available, and air-conditioning for comfort. Close to shops and transport along Marlim/Don Juico routes.

name: Antipolo Ridge Study Loft
description: Airy loft with ridge views—great for long focus blocks. Bright, airy loft in Antipolo with sweeping ridge views—built for deep work. Stable Wi-Fi, air-conditioning, scenic seating, and charging at every desk; quiet policy observed. Quick access to Sumulong Hwy and nearby cafés.

name: GenSan Brainworks
description: Bright open desks with reliable Wi-Fi and on-site printing. Modern co-working space in General Santos with sunlit open desks and enterprise-grade Wi-Fi. On-site printer, ergonomic seating, and air-conditioning; pantry and meeting rooms available. Convenient to major routes near J. Catolico Ave.
